label: Comparison of Proteomic Analysis of Cerebrospinal Fluid From Neurological Patients With and Without Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterised by progressive muscle weakness in both bulbar and extremity muscles, leading to a diverse clinical phenotype with motor and non-motor symptoms. Approximately 85% of ALS cases are sporadic (sALS), while the remaining 10%-15% are familial (fALS).
